id.instruksi: Robot belum lengkap. Dengarkan, lalu sentuh bagian tubuh yang harus dipasang.
id.t-kepala1: Robot belum punya kepala. Pasang yang mana?
id.t-kepala2: Di atas badan robot masih kosong. Pasang bagian tempat mata dan mulut.
id.t-kepala3: Robot mau melihat dan berbicara. Pasang bagian paling atas.
id.t-badan1: Robot belum punya badan. Pasang yang mana?
id.t-badan2: Bagian tengah robot masih kosong, di antara kepala dan kaki.
id.t-tangan1: Robot belum punya tangan. Pasang yang mana?
id.t-tangan2: Robot mau memegang bola, tapi sisi badannya masih kosong.
id.t-tangan3: Robot mau melambai. Pasang bagian di kiri dan kanan badan.
id.t-kaki1: Robot belum punya kaki. Pasang yang mana?
id.t-kaki2: Robot mau berjalan. Pasang bagian paling bawah.
id.t-kaki3: Robot mau melompat, tapi di bawah badannya masih kosong.

en.instruksi: The robot is not finished. Listen, then touch the body part it needs.
en.t-kepala1: The robot has no head yet. Which one goes on?
en.t-kepala2: The top of the robot's body is empty. Put on the part with the eyes and mouth.
en.t-kepala3: The robot wants to see and talk. Put on the very top part.
en.t-badan1: The robot has no body yet. Which one goes on?
en.t-badan2: The middle of the robot is empty, between the head and the legs.
en.t-tangan1: The robot has no arms yet. Which one goes on?
en.t-tangan2: The robot wants to hold a ball, but the sides of its body are empty.
en.t-tangan3: The robot wants to wave. Put on the parts at the left and right of the body.
en.t-kaki1: The robot has no legs yet. Which one goes on?
en.t-kaki2: The robot wants to walk. Put on the very bottom part.
en.t-kaki3: The robot wants to jump, but below its body is empty.

itemCount.keterangan: tiga pilihan per pertanyaan: satu bagian tubuh benar, sisanya bagian lain atau alat
